snippets.title: Evidence first
snippets.text: Separate observed facts, inferences and unknowns. Test the most consequential assumption. Never invent access, tests or completion.

snippets.title: Build and verify
snippets.text: Inspect the actual artifacts. Establish a baseline. Make a reversible improvement. Run the relevant tests and deliver the complete result with evidence and remaining limits.
